info.name: MR SANTOSH GROCERY — COMPLETE PRODUCTION API (FINAL)
info.description:
Complete production API — 435 endpoints (425 existing + 5 new fix endpoints + 5 pre-filled role logins). Every existing + all newly built APIs included, nothing missing.

Base URL: https://mr-santosh-grocery-backend.onrender.com/api/v1

═══ FIRST TIME SETUP (fresh database, no admin exists yet) ═══
1. Get ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET from Render environment variables
2. Run: POST /admin/seed/bootstrap-admin with {"secret": "..."}
   -> creates admin@mrsantoshgrocery.com / Admin@12345
3. Login as that admin -> copy accessToken -> paste into auth_token
4. Run: POST /admin/seed/demo-accounts (idempotent)
5. Run: POST /admin/seed/fix-all

═══ DEMO LOGIN CREDENTIALS (all passwords: Demo@12345) ═══
Restaurant: demo.restaurant@mrsantosh.com -> Demo Restaurant + 2 menu items + 3 tickets
Retailer:   demo.retailer@mrsantosh.com   -> Demo Organic Rice 5kg (USD) + Himalayan Pink Salt (NPR 350) + 2 reviews + 1 ticket
Supplier:   demo.supplier@mrsantosh.com   -> Demo Bulk Flour 50kg + 1 ticket
Delivery:   demo.delivery@mrsantosh.com   -> ready to accept deliveries
Customer:   demo.customer@mrsantosh.com   -> authored the demo reviews

═══ KHALTI / ESEWA ═══
Live Khalti keys are configured. eSewa uses public sandbox test credentials by default
(safe — no real money moves in sandbox mode).

═══ LATEST ADDITIONS (this update) ═══
- Delivery Panel: bank details (get/update), pickup photo upload, delivery photo upload,
  cash collection, OTP verification (completes the order) — these existed in code but
  were never wired to any route until now
- Delivery Panel: dedicated Notification Settings (push/email/sms/Do Not Disturb) — was
  previously just a duplicate of the profile endpoint with no real preference storage
- Delivery Panel: Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy content endpoints
- Delivery Panel: successRate now included in earnings response
- Order tracking: customer now sees their deliveryOTP (to hand to the driver), plus
  pickup/delivery photo URLs and cash-collected status
- Fixed a real crash bug: OTP verification referenced an undefined variable (DriverProfile
  instead of DeliveryProfile) — would have thrown a 500 the moment it was ever called
- Admin bootstrap: POST /admin/seed/bootstrap-admin — solves the chicken-and-egg problem
  of needing an admin token to run seed endpoints on a brand new database
- B2B Supplier Marketplace: search suppliers, browse catalog, supply cart, checkout
- Restaurant Panel + Supplier Panel: Support Tickets, Live Chat, FAQ, Contact Info
- Retailer Panel: Reviews & Ratings with stats + reply
- Marketplace browse endpoints (customer-facing) added to Retailer + Restaurant panels
- Demo seed extended: reviews, support tickets, and an NPR-priced demo product

═══ PREVIOUSLY ADDED (still included) ═══
eSewa + Khalti payment flows, permanent GridFS/S3 image storage, Invoices, 2FA,
Saved Cards, Customer Dashboard, Cart pricing, Wishlist null-filtering, Product Detail
enrichment, Forgot Password token-in-response, Restaurant 1-per-owner + approval flow,
rate limiter removed, register() crash fixed

═══ LATEST FIX ═══
- Admin Panel: POST /admin/users (Create User) was missing — now added, matching GET/GET/PUT/PUT/PUT/DELETE already in place for Users section.
- Restaurant Panel: GET /orders/history/export, GET /reports/export, GET /expenses/export (CSV downloads — did not exist before)
- Restaurant Panel: GET /orders/:id/invoice (restaurant-role-scoped invoice view; the shared /invoices/:id routes are customer/admin only)
- Restaurant Panel: GET /support/livechat/:sessionId (poll route — was documented in code comments but never registered, so polling always 404'd)
- Order status now accepts frontend aliases: cooking->preparing, completed/complete->delivered, accepted->confirmed
- Order lookups (status update, invoice, get-by-id) now accept either the Mongo _id or the display orderId (e.g. #ORD-8825)
- Expense category/type matching is now case-insensitive (fixes 'Inventory enum is invalid' 422)
- Added 5 pre-filled Login requests under Auth (Admin + 4 demo roles) — no more manually swapping the one generic Login body

request.description:
Issues #4/#23. Full filter set (all optional, combine as needed):
  status        = delivered | cancelled
  type          = food | grocery (matches orderType)
  paymentMethod = card | wallet | cash | esewa | khalti
  dateFrom      = YYYY-MM-DD
  dateTo        = YYYY-MM-DD
  search        = matches order ID (partial, case-insensitive)
  page, limit
Base set only ever includes delivered/cancelled orders — this endpoint is history, not live orders.

Issue #3. Accepts: confirmed, preparing, ready, delivered, cancelled — plus aliases the frontend already sends: cooking->preparing, completed/complete->delivered, accepted->confirmed. :order_id accepts either the Mongo _id or the display orderId (e.g. #ORD-8825, with or without the #).
Issue #5/#13. Returns CSV file (Content-Disposition: attachment). Same filters as Order History.

Issue #15. Restaurant-role-scoped invoice view (the shared /invoices/:id routes are customer/admin only and 403 for restaurant role). :order_id accepts either the Mongo _id or the display orderId (with or without leading #).

Backend issue #7 fixed: category/type matching is now case-insensitive (was rejecting 'salary'/'inventory' lowercase with a 422 even though the enum technically allowed 'Salary'/'Inventory'). This example intentionally sends lowercase to prove it now normalizes correctly.
Issue #13/#16. Same filters as Get Expenses.
Issue #13/#16. Daily revenue/orders as CSV.
Issue #17. Poll this every 3-5s for new messages. No socket server in this stack by design. This exact route was documented in code comments but never registered until now.
